claude_proposed_widenings.name: passive_class_feature family
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Thief's Reflexes has no activation cost, no use count, no rest reset, and no resource. It is an always-on passive modifier that fires at the start of every combat. The current ClassFeatureMechanics only has family 'activation', which requires activationCost, resource (use_count), and resetCadence — none of which apply here. A 'passive' family (or equivalent always-on family) is needed to represent features that are structural modifications to how a creature participates in combat.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: grant_extra_turn
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The feature grants a second full turn in the initiative order — not an extra action within an existing turn. This is mechanically distinct from grant_extra_action (Action Surge): the rogue participates in the initiative sequence a second time with their full action economy (action, bonus action, movement, reaction). No existing effect atom covers this. The atom needs to carry: (a) an initiative offset specifying where the extra turn falls relative to the creature's normal initiative, and (b) a scope restricting it to the first round of combat.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You take your first turn at your normal Initiative and your second turn at your Initiative minus 10.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: grant_extra_turn variant
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Even if a passive family were added, ClassFeatureEffect needs a new variant. The existing union (GrantExtraActionEffect | HealHpEffect) has no entry for granting an additional turn in the initiative order. The new variant would need at minimum: { kind: 'grant_extra_turn', initiativeOffset: number, scope: 'first_round_of_combat' }.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: your second turn at your Initiative minus 10

claude_proposed_widenings.name: RestResetCadence: per_combat (or absent for passive)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The current RestResetCadence options (short_or_long_rest, long_rest, short_rest, partial_short_full_long) all describe rest-based refills for use_count resources. Thief's Reflexes has no expendable resource — it applies every combat automatically. For a passive family, the reset cadence concept is inapplicable, but if the activation family were stretched to fit, a 'per_combat' cadence (resource refreshes at the start of each combat) would be needed.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take two turns during the first round of any combat.
